kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتناغم (form VI)
# نَتَنَاغَمُ (natanāḡamu) /na.ta.naː.ɣa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# نَتَنَاغَمَ (natanāḡama) /na.ta.naː.ɣa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# نَتَنَاغَمْ (natanāḡam) /na.ta.naː.ɣam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
